verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Granola serves an llms.txt at docs.granola.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200). It indexes Markdown versions of the help-center pages and advertises a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 spec, so an agent can be pointed directly at machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: evidence of an llms-full.txt or agent-specific usage guidance, and independent hands-on reports of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
